login.app_password_help: Generate an app password from your Attimo security profile (Agent Studio scope), then paste it here.

events.title: Choose your event
events.empty: No active events. Create an event in your Attimo dashboard.

config.folder_required: Please select a folder to watch.
config.existing_include: Upload existing files in the folder
config.parallel_hint: 3 suits most networks. Go up to 6 if your bandwidth allows; drop back to 1 only if uploads fail. On 5G, uploading is often much slower than on 4G: stick to 4G only when you can.
config.video_camera_required: Choose a camera, or turn off the video block.
config.video_micro_warning: Without a microphone, videos will be silent.
config.video_quality_hint: {rate} Mb/s. A lower definition fills the disk less and reads just as well.
config.video_folder_required: Please choose a recording folder for the video.
config.video_split_ok: A clip starts every {step} s, in {segment} s pieces ({count} per clip).
config.video_split_warning: Awkward split: {segment} s pieces, {count} per clip. Try rounder values.
config.video_split_invalid: Overlap must stay shorter than the clip duration.
config.video_send_hd: Send full quality during the race
config.video_send_hd_hint: Otherwise, HD clips wait on the disk: send them whenever you like with the "Send HD now" button on the monitoring screen. On a saturated network, this avoids slowing down photo uploads.
config.disk_pending: Choose a camera and a folder to estimate the space needed.
config.disk_detail: {free} GB free, {reserved} GB reserved for the system
config.nothing_enabled: Turn on photos or video, at least one.
config.hd_pending_text: {count} HD clip(s) from this event are waiting to be sent ({size} GB).

dashboard.video_started: Recording started — a clip every {step} s
dashboard.video_disk_full: Not enough disk space — recording stopped
dashboard.confirm_stop: Stop watching and return to event selection?
dashboard.video_paused_log: Recording paused — the current clip was closed and is sent with the others
dashboard.video_throttled: Server overloaded: video upload paused for {delay} s

upload.success_timing: OK in {duration} s — network {network} s + server {server} s
upload.throttled: Server overloaded ({code}): pausing {delay} s, {parallel} parallel upload(s)

connection.lost: Connection lost — files are queuing up
connection.expired: Session expired — please sign in again

hd.title: HD video
hd.all_sent: All HD clips have been sent.
hd.hint: HD is sent from the agent, never from the gallery: sent from the gallery, it creates a duplicate. Photos keep priority.

nav.confirm_replace: A session is running for "{event}". End it to start this one?
nav.confirm_logout: A session is running. End it and log out?
